corrections.corrected_text: ⟪ወይቤልዎ ፡ ትሬኢኑ ፡ ኦ ፡ እኍነ ፡ ሚ ፡ መጠን ፡ አ
corrections.reason: In Classical Ge'ez (Acts 21:20), 'our brother' is 'እኍነ' (with 2nd-order ኍ, clearly visible in the image), and the final character before 'አላፍ' on the next line is 'አ' (forming 'አአላፍ' across the line break), not 'ጸ'.

The image clearly prints 'እንድታስተው' ('that you make them abandon/leave'), which directly translates the Ge'ez root verb 'ወታኅድጎሙ' ('and you make them forsake [the law of Moses]'). Stage 1 hallucinated 'እንድታስተምር' from line 18.
